purpose: Teach: 率いる/解っ/おこなっ/御座い/ことごとく/いたす/こんなにも/みつけ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが少年団を率いる先生役なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is the teacher leading the youth group, you know.
lines.style: Warm, informative tone. Gentle pacing. Speaking to a child with patient clarity, as if sharing something she's noticed and thinks he should know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの話が解ってきたよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I'm starting to understand what Dad does!
lines.style: Bright, eager voice. Quick attack on the opening. Gentle breathiness of a child discovering something. Rising slightly at the end with pride and the desire for her acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが運動会をおこなって下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to run the sports day, apparently.
lines.style: Soft, almost marveling tone. Slight pause before the verb, as if noting his effort. Warm undercurrent — she notices what he's doing and finds it touching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ありがとう御座います」って言ったよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I told Dad 'thank you very much'!
lines.style: Proud, bright delivery. Clear enunciation on the polite phrase — he's repeating it because he's pleased with himself for saying it correctly. Energy lifting at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが絵本をことごとく読んで下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has read every picture book to you, hasn't he.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful. Speaking as if cataloging small acts of care. Slow, deliberate pacing. No question mark — more a quiet acknowledgment of devotion.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「お願いいたす」って言えたよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I was able to ask Dad for things politely!
lines.style: Bright, self-assured voice. Clear articulation on the polite phrase. Quick, light pace — he's reporting success with enthusiasm. Slight swell of pride in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、こんなにもお父さんが頑張って下さってるのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is trying so hard for you.
lines.style: Soft, tender. Slow pacing. Slight emphasis on the magnitude of effort. She's reflecting back to him something she wants him to feel and remember — voice carries quiet emotion beneath the words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと貝殻をみつけたよ
lines.en: Big sister Mei, I found a seashell with Dad!
lines.style: Warm, intimate excitement. Gentle brightness. Voice softens on the memory — he's sharing something precious, a small moment that meant something. Trailing slightly, wanting her to know it mattered.
